name: project-init
description: v0.21.0: folder mounting is now environment-aware. The old assumption that `mcp__cowork__request_cowork_directory` is always present held only on-computer; in the cloud that tool is absent. /session-start, /session-end, and /init-project now detect the environment by tool availability and branch: in the cloud they detect mounts via `mcp__remote-devices__get_device_info` (`connectedFolders`), prompt the user to click Add folder for any missing root (mounting is a user-only trust action in the cloud), and replace the Finder picker with `device_list_dir` + AskUserQuestion chips for subfolder selection; on-computer they keep the `request_cowork_directory` picker/mount path. v0.20.0: /session-start now surfaces the project MOC index (the durable map) and the Taskade project-memory.md pointer in its briefing, not just the last-14-day DRs. Cowork project lifecycle for MoxyWolf projects. /init-project scaffolds tailored Project Instructions. /session-start auto-resolves the project — explicit argument, then launch directory, then the most recently active project, never a picker — mounts the three standard roots, reads the previous session's handoff including the `author` / `for` baton-pass fields, and probes the team-shared OpenRouter key (DR-010). /session-end asks who authored the handoff and whether it's a baton-pass, writes the canonical handoff with `author` / `for` frontmatter, supports --author / --handoff-to / --solo, refreshes each writable repo's README.md, then runs /obsidian-update. v0.15.0 closes the stale-handoff-reminder propagation hole: /session-start now reads Taskade/_Shared Files/_shared-memory/INDEX.md as a first-class briefing step and cross-checks the handoff's procedural-reminders section against the current INDEX, flagging any reminder that cites a missing or revised file as STALE. /session-end now requires every general behavioral reminder in the procedural-reminders section to cite a currently-existing team-shared memory file by exact filename (verified at write time), or be explicitly tagged as (session-specific). Together the two checks stop free-form recollections from overriding canonical team-shared memory across sessions — the failure mode that surfaced 2026-06-02 when a 2026-05-21 handoff carried forward a 'never run git from the sandbox' reminder that had been reversed 2026-05-20. v0.16.0 moved commit+push to sandbox git + a classic PAT (no GitHub Desktop in the loop); v0.17.0 reads that PAT from the vault file github-pat.env (DR-011), mirroring the openrouter.env pattern, and verifies each push landed via git ls-remote. v0.18.0 switches /init-project to the loader-stub model: it saves the full instructions on disk as the single source of truth and emits only a thin loader stub (mounts + file-write-path override + a read-the-file-and-shared-memory-first imperative) for the Cowork settings field, so the embedded copy can no longer drift out of sync with the on-disk file (the paste-once-never-re-paste model; DR-010). v0.19.0 moves the stub skeleton and the on-disk reconciliation directives OUT of the plugin into a vault spec (MoxyWolf Vault/_Shared Knowledge/Agents and Plugins/project-instructions-loader-stub.md) that both /init-project and the new /refresh-project-instructions command read at run time, and adds /refresh-project-instructions to migrate or re-stamp an existing project from that spec — so changing a project-instruction rule is a vault edit plus a per-project command run, never a plugin update.
